subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared final-only or last-segment-only delivery policy for phase-less channel runs, or should it change the broader automatic source-reply default?
rationale: The source fix is clear enough to implement in one area, but the user-visible contract changes compatibility and security posture for existing messaging-channel deployments.

options.title: Add shared final-only delivery mode
options.body: Add a narrow delivery-side policy at or below `buildEmbeddedRunPayloads` so phase-less runs can avoid inter-tool text leakage without making all source replies message-tool-only by default.

options.title: Change automatic defaults
options.body: Move more channel turns to `message_tool_only` or explicit-send semantics by default, accepting a larger upgrade and compatibility migration burden.

options.title: Keep automatic delivery and document workarounds
options.body: Preserve current behavior and rely on prompts/configuration, leaving the recurring leak risk to operators.

recommendation.title: Add shared final-only delivery mode
recommendation.body: Add a narrow delivery-side policy at or below `buildEmbeddedRunPayloads` so phase-less runs can avoid inter-tool text leakage without making all source replies message-tool-only by default.
